answer_1.quote: Semantic parsing tackles the task of translating an NL utterance u into a formal meaning representation (MR) z. Specifically, we focus on parsing utterances to access database tables, where z is a structured query (e.g., an SQL query) executable on a set of relational DB tables.

answer_2.quote: Evaluation Metrics As standard, we report execution accuracy on WIKITABLEQUESTIONS and exact-match accuracy of DB queries on SPIDER.
